user.title: Connect Jar
user.description: On the PC running Jar open the dashboard → Home Assistant (or from the Jar app: menu → Open dashboard → Home Assistant), copy the link and paste it here.

data.allow_control: Let Jar's memos control the house

data_description.allow_control: Makes a Home Assistant user "Jar" (not an admin). Memos can then switch whatever is exposed to Assist.

reauth_confirm.description: A new link was made on the Jar dashboard. Paste it here.

error.bad_link: That isn't a Jar link (it starts with jar://pair).
error.bad_token: Jar doesn't accept this link any more; copy a fresh one from the dashboard.
error.not_home_link: This is a phone's link. Use the one from the dashboard's Home Assistant page.
error.cannot_connect: Jar didn't answer at any of its addresses. Is the Jar PC on?
